step1_figure.circuit_type: Fully-differential op-amp with output-buffer continuous-time CMFB using triode MOSFETs
step1_figure.description: The schematic in Figure 26.43 shows a fully-differential two-stage op-amp featuring an NMOS input differential pair with PMOS cascode loads, wide-swing biasing, Miller compensation capacitors (25 fF), and an output buffer whose common-mode level is balanced via triode-operating MOSFETs (40/1 and 20/1) driven by a dedicated CMFB error amplifier.

open_loop_gain.description: Peak differential open-loop voltage gain of the op-amp

equation.formula: A_v = \frac{d(v_{op} - v_{om})}{d(v_{ip} - v_{im})} \approx g_{m1} R_{out1} \cdot g_{m2} R_{out2}
equation.explanation: Two-stage differential gain with cascode first stage and common-source output stage regulated by CMFB.
equation.assumptions: Devices in saturation, active loads present high output impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: g_m1 = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) ≈ 232 uS. First stage cascode output resistance R_out1 ≈ (g_m * r_o^2) / 2 ≈ 2.5 MOhm -> A_v1 ≈ 580 V/V. Second stage loaded by 20k feedback resistors yields overall loaded differential gain A_v ≈ 380 V/V (approx 51.6 dB) as shown in Fig 26.44(b).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Figure 26.44(b) explicitly plots peak gain deriv(vop - vom) reaching ~380 V/V (51.6 dB).

unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity-gain frequency of the forward differential signal path

equation.explanation: Determined by the transconductance of the input differential pair and the Miller compensation capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Miller compensation dominates the primary pole.

sky130_expected.calculation: With input pair NMOS W/L=10/1, I_D ≈ 10 uA, g_m = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) ≈ 232 uS. With C_c = 25 fF: f_un = 232e-6 / (2 * pi * 25e-15) ≈ 1.48 GHz. Accounting for parasitic capacitances at the high-impedance node, f_un is typically around 500 MHz - 1.2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text on page 892 specifically notes f_un = g_m / (2*pi*C_c) and explains the reduction from 50 fF to 25 fF.

settling_time.description: 1% settling time for large-signal differential step response

equation.explanation: Time required for the differential output voltage to settle within 1% of its final value.
equation.assumptions: Linear closed-loop settling with minimal slew-rate limitation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Page 892 explicitly gives: 'The settling times are approximately 1-2 ns.'
sky130_expected.reasoning: Measured directly from transient differential step simulations in closed-loop configuration.

quiescent_current.description: Total DC supply current drawn from VDD including biasing circuitry

equation.explanation: Total static current drawn by the input diff-amp, cascode branches, output stages, and CMFB amplifier.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent operating point with zero differential input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Text on page 892 specifies: 'The current drawn from VDD (including the bias circuit current) is approximately 250 uA (200 uA for the op-amp alone).'
sky130_expected.reasoning: Exact nominal value stated in the chapter text.

power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent power consumption of the operational amplifier

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage and total quiescent current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from 1.8 V supply and 250 uA total current.

output_cm_voltage.description: DC common-mode voltage at the op-amp differential outputs

equation.explanation: The continuous-time CMFB circuit forces the average of the differential outputs to match the reference V_CM.
equation.assumptions: Sufficient loop gain in the CMFB feedback loop.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_CM is set to 500 mV (0.5 V). With high CMFB loop gain, V_out,cm = (v_op + v_om)/2 ≈ 0.50 V.

differential_offset_gain.description: Differential output voltage resulting from input-referred offset voltage

equation.explanation: Closed-loop differential output offset caused by an input offset voltage V_OS.

sky130_expected.calculation: With R_f = 20k and R_in = 20k, 1 + R_f/R_in = 2. For an offset V_OS = 50 mV, v_op - v_om = 50 mV * 2 = 100 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Eq. (26.13) gives exactly 2 * V_OS for equal feedback resistors.

input_cm_voltage.description: DC common-mode voltage at the virtual ground inputs vm and vp

equation.explanation: Voltage established at the op-amp input terminals by resistor averaging between input and output.
equation.assumptions: Equal input and feedback resistors (R_in = R_f = 20k).

sky130_expected.calculation: When V_CMI = V_CM = 500 mV and V_OS = 0 V: v_m = v_p = 500 mV * (0.5 + 0.5) = 500 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct evaluation of Eq. (26.15) with balanced common-mode levels.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice testbench for Baker Fig 26.43 op-amp measuring open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, transient settling time, common-mode output regulation, and DC quiescent power.
